title: Three Village Historical Society and Museum
summary: A public museum and archive in East Setauket preserving local history, including Setalcott oral histories and community records.
address_label: 93 North Country Road, East Setauket, NY
map_geometry_source: Public museum address verified against institution visit page and Google Maps place record, September 17, 2026.
why_this_matters: Listening to local people changes how a place is understood. This museum offers a way to encounter Setalcott community memory alongside the colonial records that often dominate accounts of the North Shore.
history_content:
The museum preserves recorded Setalcott elder interviews, photographs, and documents. These materials connect family memory with the wider history of Setauket.1

Community authority in public history

Its October 2025 statement, written with the Setalcott Nation, commits to shared stewardship and Setalcott authority over interpretation and conservation of Native materials. It remembers former trustee Chief Theodore “Blue Medicine” Green and his work to make Black and Indigenous histories more visible.1
whereintheworld_content: The pin marks the public museum at 93 North Country Road, East Setauket, just north of the Thompson House. Check the museum’s visit page for current admission, exhibitions, and opening hours; archival access and particular materials may require an inquiry.2
